facts.rationale: Corrects the unsupported air-resistance interpretation using the canonical second physics helper and preserves the conditional nature of settling after terrain contact.
facts.value: Runs in Bat state slots 1 and 3, whose shared physics processes falling and computes spin speed rather than air resistance. It delegates terrain handling to it_8026E15C with it_80284974 as the grounded-state callback. The helper invokes that callback only after its contact and landing checks succeed; the callback resets velocity and landing count and selects state 0. This wrapper itself always returns false.

evidence.why: Wrapper, false result and state-1 destination.
Floor metadata, ground-loss callback and exceptional supported-floor call.

facts.rationale: Preserves the existing ground-loss transition while adding the exceptional supported-floor branch omitted by the blanket state-preservation explanation. The downstream meaning of Item_8026ADC0 is deliberately not guessed.
facts.value: Delegates state-0 floor processing to it_8026D62C and always returns false. The helper refreshes collision position and records the floor index when supported. Loss of floor contact performs leave-ground setup and invokes it_802849F0, selecting state 1 and resetting landing count. On the supported-floor path, it additionally calls Item_8026ADC0 when it_80277544(gobj) is nonzero and xDCD_flag.b3 is clear; therefore valid floor contact does not imply that no further item-event processing occurs.
